summary:
Implementation plan for simplifying the Pantryo interface based on user clarification answers:
1. Streamline top header actions to feature the primary quick actions (Camera Scanner & Quick Add item) while maintaining a clean, clutter-free action bar.
2. Replace the dual horizontal filter chip strips (storage locations and 10+ food category chips) with a unified single filter row with an intuitive compact filter drawer/sheet.
3. Keep the 4 top storage metric cards intact for at-a-glance status while reducing visual clutter across the inventory home view.
